listing.name: Diablo (DevilutionX)
listing.summary: Play Diablo through DevilutionX with your matching original game files.

steps.title: Choose the runtime owner and original set
steps.instruction: The managed Windows and Linux x64 offer prepares only its reviewed complete original-file set and owns its new private runtime/profile. The following upstream setup steps are the non-owning alternative for other permitted original editions or an existing player. Keep its original files and profile separately; existing registrations are not converted. One entry in a library cannot hold both runtime owners concurrently.

steps.title: Use this original game and edition
steps.instruction: Use DIABDAT.MPQ from your own original PC Diablo CD or installation. The documented SPAWN.MPQ shareware provides limited shareware content only. Keep the packaged devilutionx.mpq; optional fonts and voice packs have separate upstream requirements. Keep your originals elsewhere unchanged; upstream handles its own data recognition and preparation. A Portcove registration does not authenticate original-game files.

steps.title: Prepare upstream and select the real player
steps.instruction: Extract the complete official Windows x86_64 ZIP and keep devilutionx.exe, devilutionx.mpq and all runtime companions together. A GOG installation may be detected; otherwise supply the matching MPQs beside the player or in the actual data directory described by upstream. Register devilutionx.exe inside its wrapper, using that same folder as working directory. Use the documented single argument --diablo to select this entry’s game even when both games’ files are present.

steps.title: Keep the actual original and player data
steps.instruction: The Windows data/profile location is normally %APPDATA%/diasurgical/devilution, with upstream portable/path overrides depending on the selected setup. Preserve the actual configuration, character saves and MPQ locations as well as the working copy, with all players closed before changing versions. Diablo and Hellfire modes have different original-data and save semantics. No automatic character conversion or cross-version save guarantee is supplied by registration.

steps.title: Add the game and manage your files
steps.instruction: Finish setup with the project’s tools before adding the game. Portcove saves your selected executable, working folder and launch arguments; choose Play separately when you are ready. You manage this game’s files, original files and profile. Removing its registration leaves those files in place. Portcove does not offer updates, backups, rollback, data migration or file deletion for this external copy. Keep a working copy and its data before changing versions. The Linux reference below separates managed installation from upstream setup. Use the upstream application for the Mac and mobile instructions.

references.title: Choose a DevilutionX route on Linux
references.instruction: The managed x86-64 route uses the official AppImage and the original-file chooser. The reviewed AppImage needs glibc 2.34 or later and a working FUSE setup. For a separate upstream-owned copy, make the AppImage executable and supply your matching MPQs in its actual data folder, normally ~/.local/share/diasurgical/devilution. For the x86-64 tar.xz, extract it into a new setup folder with Portcove Download or your archive tool, keep the complete package and start devilutionx.sh. On Linux ARM64 use the separate AArch64 tar.xz, install the needed SDL2 and SDL2_image libraries, and start devilutionx from the extracted folder. Use the game mode that matches your original data.

references.title: Prepare DevilutionX on Mac
references.instruction: Use the upstream macOS-universal DMG on Intel or Apple Silicon. Copy devilutionX.app out of the image and keep the complete bundle. Put the matching MPQs in ~/Library/Application Support/diasurgical/devilution unless you already use a custom directory. Select Diablo in the upstream game mode if Hellfire data are also present. On either desktop platform, preserve the actual config, character saves and original files, including overrides. The upstream license governs use of the external copy.

references.title: Prepare DevilutionX on Android, iPhone or iPad
references.instruction: On Android, install the upstream 1.5.5 APK or use Google Play. Use Import Data in the app to choose your files. Import your full Diablo DIABDAT.MPQ and select Diablo if Hellfire data are also present. The app copies the selected files into its external files directory, usually Android/data/org.diasurgical.devilutionx/files. Keep your originals and preserve that directory’s actual game data, saves and settings before replacing or removing the app. Use the same distribution channel for updates so the Android package signer remains compatible. On iPhone or iPad, use the official 1.5.5 IPA with your own sideloading and signing setup on iOS or iPadOS 13 or later. Open the app once, then close it. Use Finder or iTunes file sharing to copy your owned DIABDAT.MPQ to the app’s Documents folder. Select Diablo in the app. Keep the Documents folder, including .sv characters and stashes and the configuration, before changing the installation.

presentation.manual_preparation: Select a folder or ZIP containing your complete matching DIABDAT.MPQ through the original-file chooser. This managed offer accepts the reviewed complete original set; other editions, the shareware demo and optional class archives use the separate upstream-owned route. Originals are not included. Upstream may also read recognized outside data locations; Core does not own or back up those files. Portcove prepares verified immutable copies under originals beside the player, and keeps settings, characters, stash, screenshots, demos and temporary data under the separate profile folder. Play uses the selected Diablo mode. Keep Diablo and Hellfire in their own entries and profiles; character conversion, cross-mode saves and older-reader compatibility are not established. Do not change this entry’s original set in place. Existing registrations stay externally owned; this offer does not adopt their populated runtime, original files or profile. Use a separate library or independently owned upstream copy for another original set, profile or owner. Preserve the creating runtime and current profile before changing versions. Outside-tree paths and unclaimed inside-tree modifications are outside this managed scope and can hold maintenance. Removal preserves the declared profile and external originals; retained profile data requires its creating contract before reuse.
